value.message: Cartwheels Gym Centre runs Tiny Gym for ages 1 and walking to 3 with a parent - their site says Term 1 is Sept 14 to Nov 1 and Term 2 is Nov 2 to Dec 20, but I could not pin down the day or price. Their site says Term 1 registration opened July 22 at 8am online. I'll keep watching and text you when I have the days and price.
